checks.name: dimensionless_metrics
checks.interpretation: Physics-inspired variables are normalized measurable ratios, not decorative symbols.

checks.name: homeostasis_damps_perturbation
checks.interpretation: Higher H must reduce integrated perturbation deviation in the toy response model.

checks.name: plasticity_homeostasis_tradeoff
checks.interpretation: Plasticity without homeostasis can underperform a balanced adaptive regime.

checks.name: failure_immunity_transfer
checks.interpretation: A valid antibody should attenuate repeat failures in related tasks more than unrelated tasks.

checks.name: cost_budget
checks.interpretation: Engineering claims must report compute/cost budgets, not only performance deltas.

checks.name: release_acceptance_gate
checks.interpretation: A publishable row must pass metric, stability, provenance, budget, and duplicate-cell gates.

checks.name: falsification_conditions
checks.interpretation: A positive delta is rejected when checkpoint provenance is missing or the task mixture changed.
